name: Pasquale Tridico - § 30 - Am 6
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text: 30. Stresses that unanimity voting is a core principle of the Treaties that protects the rights of all Member States; rejects calls for treaty reforms that limit or decrease the application of unanimity voting;
